summary: Artech Studios and Sega's 32X motocross racing game with combat, twelve tracks, stunts, and a password-saved season mode.

emulation.notes: Use original 32X hardware or a compatible emulator with accurate 32X support.

primary.why: Motocross Championship is sourced as a Sega-published 1995 racing game developed for the 32X, with 32X as its only listed platform. With no sourced ports or remasters, the original 32X release is the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Sega Genesis/Mega Drive with 32X hardware or a compatible emulator that supports 32X accurately.

all_releases.fidelity: Original 32X motorcycle-combat racer with twelve courses, head-to-head multiplayer, and season mode.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only one sourced platform route; no secondary content route.
